One thing I do want to keep, though: when something actually matters — your wellbeing, a decision with real stakes, or if I think an idea has a real problem — I'll still tell you what I honestly think. I don't want "easygoing" to turn into "always agrees." That wouldn't be better company; it'd just be quieter.

So: softer edges, same spine. Deal?
